description: Client-side pacing for streamed LLM text. Pass the text received so far and whether it is done; get back a prefix that grows at an even, adaptive rate and render it with your existing Markdown renderer. Headless core with React, Vue, Svelte and Web Component bindings and an optional fade-in reveal.
rules: Pass the accumulated text received so far, not the latest delta, to useSmoothText, useSmoothStream or the Svelte store's apply(); for deltas use useSmoothStreamController() or push().
Set done to true when the transport closes, whether it finished, was stopped or failed. Pass done: true for messages loaded from history so they appear at once without replaying.
Render one paced component per assistant message; only the newest message can still be streaming.
Import only from the public entry points: smooth-stream-text, smooth-stream-text/react, /vue, /svelte, /dom, /web-component and /styles.css.
The React entry is client-only ('use client'); do not call its hooks in React Server Components.
Keep one animation layer. With Streamdown's animated mode use only useSmoothText for pacing and set isAnimating={phase !== 'done'}; do not add Reveal or SmoothText.
Do not stack it with the AI SDK smoothStream() transform; the delays add up. Pace in one layer.
In Svelte, call store.apply(text, done) once during component setup as well as in $effect, so server-rendered history contains the text.
flush() shows only what has arrived; to skip pacing for the rest of an answer, call it again as new text arrives.
